intro: Tucked away high in the dusty hills of the Badlands lies a secluded underground tomb known simply as the Crypt. Inside rests the silent remnant of an ancient warrior: an armored skeleton seated upon a stone throne, flanked by urns, chests, and a massive relic sword.

sections.t: The Tomb of the Barbarian King
p: Perched southeast of Hammertoe's Digsite along an unmarked earthen path rising up the hillside, the Badlands Crypt is easily missed by passersby. Down in its dark stone chambers sits an armored skeleton poised atop a throne. Resting beside the remains is the Sword of the Barbarian King, surrounded by scattered bones, urns, and forgotten chests. While miners and adventurers frequent the surrounding gullies in search of dwarven ruins and riches, the true origin and history of this seated sovereign remain a mystery lost to the arid wastes.
